scope.operation: Preserve native DXF/DWG OCS point fields when a caller reads DIMENSION with applyExtrusion enabled and then serializes the result.
behavior: DRW_Dimension::applyExtrusion transforms the modeled text, clone, and angular-arc OCS points to WCS and records the transformed state using the existing haveExtrusion flag; no object-layout or virtual-interface change is made.
DXF and DWG writers project only those transformed fields back into the native OCS frame before writing the extrusion vector; WCS definition fields remain unchanged.
Generated ASCII/Binary controls cover nine DIMENSION subtypes, four extrusion normals, raw and transformed read modes, output/readback, and a following-entity boundary sentinel.
A generated AC1015 DWG write/read control confirms the common text/clone OCS projection and the two-line angular-dimension arc point projection.

coverage: Local DWG round-trip aggregate, including generated AC1015 writer/readback of applied-extrusion DIMENSION points.
Generated ASCII/Binary DIMENSION mixed-frame output/readback for nine subtypes, four extrusion normals and raw/applyExtrusion reads, with following-entity boundary checks.
Generated ASCII/Binary CLI DIMENSION-frame conversion and ARC_DIMENSION flag/readback controls.
